name: Anaerobic Methanogenic Archaea
description: Methanogens are among the simplest and most ancient known metabolisms. They produce methane from CO₂ and H₂.
source: Takai et al. (2008), DOI:10.1073/pnas.0712797105; Merino et al. (2020)
limitations: Tolerance ranges are laboratory envelopes, not field distributions
Energy model assumes thermodynamic availability, not kinetic barriers
Nutrient availability (N, P, S, Fe, trace metals) not modeled
Competition with other organisms not modeled
